item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.25
item.description: - Refine a QA review’s summary in place. Open any finding to edit its title and description before handoff. - Open screenshots in a larger viewer with Copy Screenshot and Close. Read the original transcript from the review. - Choose Parakeet v2 in Speech Models for English-only transcription on Apple Silicon.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.26
item.description: Dictation recovery now offers Paste and Save with one line of guidance. Retry sends only pending content to the chosen input. Save keeps the full transcript and screenshots. This update also improves WezTerm pasting and protects screenshot delivery when macOS Secure Input is active.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.27
item.description: Saved captures use their heading or opening sentence. Meetings and QA reviews get content-based titles and keep names you choose. QA findings and meeting summaries preserve your perspective. Recording controls and on-device summaries recover more reliably. Selection results have more reading room and consistent spacing between action rows. Sign in with Google.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.28
item.description: Capture controls stay in place when you resize a saved note, meeting, or QA review. You can edit, copy, run a workflow, or open the item in Codex or Claude with the sidebar open. Resume a pending review above the document.
